findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：美國政府核部件與燃料因技術、法規與資本門檻，競爭有限；主要對手列有 Bechtel、Fluor、Northrop、HII、Westinghouse 等。
findings.excerpt: Because of the technical and regulatory standards required to meet U.S. Government contracting requirements for nuclear components and fuel and the barriers to entry present in this type of environment, competition is limited.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：商用部門對手含 Framatome、Cameco、Doosan、AECON、Westinghouse、AtkinsRéalis；核醫對手含 Curium、SHINE、Jubilant。
findings.excerpt: This segment competes with a number of companies specializing in nuclear capabilities including, but not limited to, Framatome, Cameco Corporation, Doosan Heavy Industries & Construction Co., Ltd., AECON Group Inc., Westinghouse Electric Corporation and AtkinsRéalis.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：無法保證現有技術維持競爭力或不被競爭技術顛覆。
findings.excerpt: there can be no assurance that the current technologies that our business relies upon will remain competitive, or that competing technologies will not disrupt our business.
